ssl.label: 11:20 range low - held four times, never closed below

narrative: A TIME-OF-DAY STRUCTURE, NOT A CHART READ, AND IT ANSWERED A QUESTION THE USER ASKED ABOUT THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION. The user asked whether a LONG existed at CMP. Measured across 57 sessions entering at 11:55, long was negative in every geometry tested (33/29/47/50/29 percent against break-evens of 40/40/59/60/40). Short was positive in every geometry, +10 to +12, best at stop 50 target 35: 37/15 for 71 percent against a 59 percent break-even, z approximately 1.77. THE ARTIFACT CHECK IS WHY THIS WAS OFFERED AT ALL. A blanket short edge across a whole sample usually means the sample trended down. It did not: NIFTY rose 3.4 percent over the period with 50 percent up days, afternoon drift was neutral (mean -6.9, median +9.4, negative in 46 percent of sessions), and splitting the sample in half gave 71 percent in BOTH halves while the afternoon drift itself flipped from -38.9 to +23.9. An edge that survives the drift reversing sign is not a drift artifact. IT CONTRADICTED THE FADE-LONG ARMED EARLIER AND THAT WAS STATED BEFORE ENTRY. The 11:20 fade would have said BUY on a close below 24138.00, 18 points from this short's entry and opposite it. Holding both was incoherent; the user chose this one and the fade was stood down. OUTCOME: closed manually at a loss BEFORE the stop. Filled 59.20 against a 60.20 quoted ask. Ran to +9.8 percent at 12:09 with spot at 24138.15, then round-tripped as 24138.00 held for a fourth time and reversed. Exited 50.00 at 12:40 with spot 24175.50 - 19.75 points against entry, still 30.25 points clear of the 24205.75 stop. Net -652.76 rupees after 54.76 of charges. THE EXIT WAS AGAINST THE MEASURED RULE AND THAT IS RECORDED PLAINLY. Conditional on the exact state at the time (open 40 minutes, underwater 3+ points) the sample still gave 63 percent, above the 59 percent break-even, and holding carried +157 rupees of expectancy against a certain -585. The user was told this and chose to cut. That is a legitimate risk-tolerance decision, explicitly flagged as such before it was made, and it is not scored as an analytical error - but the trade is scored as a LOSS because it was one. VERIFIER: check 12 corrected; checks 8 and 9 left failing on purpose. Check 8 (R:R 0.70 vs the 1.5 index intraday floor) is accurate and deliberate - a high-hit-rate structure. Check 9 is the FOURTH instance in three days of a stop sitting inside the block it protects against; it is not moved retroactively because the trade was taken at 24205.75 and editing it would falsify the record.
invalidation: A 5M close above 24205.75 - never reached; the position was closed manually 30.25 points short of it. The 50-point stop against a 35-point target is deliberate: expectancy in this setup comes from the 71 percent hit rate, not the ratio, so tightening the stop to improve R:R would have moved the trade out of the measured structure entirely. That was stated before entry and the user was warned specifically against the middle path of moving the stop closer.
